name: Human to Werewolf
summary: Get scratched on the back by a strong werewolf and wait for the moon.
method: A werewolf's scratch, then the full moon
requirements: You must be [[human]]. Turn back first with a [[human-potion]] if you are not.
steps: Find a werewolf player, or a [[werewolf-npcs|werewolf NPC]] of Lv 6,000 or higher.
Get scratched on the back until the infection takes.
Wait for the [[full-moon]]. You turn the moment it rises.
disputed: The Werewolf page applies the Lv 6,000 limit to NPCs only; the Beginner Guide applies it to any werewolf.
notes: There is no quest, boss or shop route.
